range.quote: Ebike range depends on many factors, including rider and equipment weight, weather conditions, route choice, assist level and more. The MAHLE X30 system paired with MAHLE's 237Wh iX2 battery is designed to offer a range of up to 45 miles (72 kilometers) per charge under ideal conditions. MAHLE range-extender batteries (sold separately) greatly increase the ground you can cover with assist.
